newsitem.title: USA: Trump says reports on 55 Wall Street buy accurate.
newsitem.headline: Trump says reports on 55 Wall Street buy accurate.

text.p: Donald Trump said on Monday reports that he was planning to buy 55 Wall Street for $20 million were "very accurate."
Trump made the remakr at a shareholders' meeting.
The New York Times said on Saturday Trump was purchasing the New York architectural and historic landmark from Commercial Development International/East, a subsidiary of Kajima Corp.
The paper quoted Trump as saying in an interview he would close the deal by year-end.
It said Trump had put up 10 percent of the price and signed an agreement to buy the building a week ago.
The paper said Trump declined to comment on his plans for the site.

The building, which has a domed Wedgewood ceiling, originally housed the New York Stock Exchange but was taken over by the federal government in 1863 for use as the New York Customs House, the paper said.
